meta.title: Memory switch
meta.description: Adds a switch to the composer tool row's left group in every conversation. While it is off, that conversation stops exchanging information with other conversations: cross-conversation history search and trace tools are denied, cross-conversation references and team relay messages are filtered out, and OpenViking recall, capture and commits are gated while another conversation's memory stays out of the request. State is stored in the session log, so reload, resume and fork restore it; subagents inherit it. On by default.
